name: aswath-skill-router
description: Learns which skill a request actually needs from what really happens in a session - the ask, the edits, the corrections, the deletes - and feeds that back into the capability router so the same mistake is not made twice.
author: Aswath
exampleQueries: Which skill does this request actually need?
What has the router learned about my skill choices?
Learn from this session and update the routing ledger.
